Repeat the measurement at the maximum rated speed and compare all six readings against the baseline vibration record from the previous service.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Apply Prussian blue to a clean test arbor and insert it into the spindle taper bore. Rotate by hand under moderate axial load for two to three turns, then withdraw and inspect the transfer pattern for uniform contact over at least 75% of the taper length.

ground_truth.node_text: Apply a thin uniform coat of Prussian blue or engineer's marking compound to the taper surface of a clean test arbor. Insert the arbor into the spindle taper bore and rotate by hand under moderate axial load for two to three turns. Withdraw the arbor and inspect the transfer pattern; uniform contact over at least 75% of the taper length is required. A patchy or one sided pattern indicates taper bore damage, swarf contamination, or arbor misalignment.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Test arbor inserted and rotated. Pattern inspected after withdrawal.

ground_truth.node_text: Apply a thin uniform coat of Prussian blue or engineer's marking compound to the taper surface of a clean test arbor. ground_truth.node_text: Mount a dial test indicator against a precision reference mandrel clamped in the spindle before starting the warm up cycle. Zero the indicator and record the position as the cold datum. Run the spindle at operating speed for 30 minutes and record the indicator position at five minute intervals. Note the total thermal displacement at stabilisation and compare against the thermal growth compensation value stored in the machine thermal model parameters.

Read the pressure gauge at the spindle taper outlet and compare against the minimum required coolant through spindle pressure. Observe the flow indicator for steady flow; pulsing or absent flow indicates a blocked spindle check valve or a failing coolant pump.

ground_truth.node_text: Load the test piece material, typically a 100 millimetre diameter aluminium or cast iron disc, into the machine work holding and run the standard spindle test machining program. Compare all results against the machined geometry tolerances in the spindle acceptance test plan.
